series: What if the countries were swapped?
title: What if Ronaldo was German?
checked: Ronaldo: Portugal debut Aug 2003 aged 18; men's record international scorer (Wikipedia, widely reported). Euro 2004 final: Greece 1-0 Portugal in Lisbon, 4 July 2004, Ronaldo 19 (Wikipedia, UEFA). Euro 2016 final: Ronaldo off injured about 25 minutes in, Éder's 109th-minute winner, 1-0 v France (Wikipedia, UEFA). Nations League 2019 and 2025 (UEFA). Germany since 2003: World Cup 2014 (7-1 v Brazil in the semi; Götze's 113th-minute volley from Schürrle's cross in the final), Confederations Cup 2017; group exits 2018 and 2022 (Wikipedia). 2026: Paraguay beat Germany 4-3 on pens after 1-1, 29 June, Germany's first World Cup shoot-out defeat (Graphic, KSL). The German-Ronaldo goal is clearly imagined. Kits in the game footage are plain.

lines.text: Cristiano Ronaldo has scored more international goals than any man in history. What if he'd scored them for Germany?
lines.say: Kristeeahno Ronaldo has scored more international goals than any man in history. What if he'd scored them for Germany?

lines.text: His Portugal story starts in tears. Euro 2004, at home in Lisbon. Aged nineteen, he loses the final to Greece.
lines.say: His Portugal story starts in tears. Euro two thousand and four, at home in Lisbon. Aged nineteen, he loses the final to Greece.

lines.text: Twelve years later, another final. Ronaldo is injured after twenty-five minutes, and leaves in tears again.
So he coaches from the touchline. And in extra time, Éder wins it from twenty-five yards.
lines.say: So he coaches from the touchline. And in extra time, Ayder wins it from twenty-five yards.

lines.text: Add two Nations Leagues, and Portugal have three trophies in his time.
Now Germany, in the same years. A seven-one against Brazil, then the World Cup in 2014.
lines.say: Now Germany, in the same years. A seven-one against Brazil, then the World Cup in twenty fourteen.

scene.note: Germany go on to win the final

lines.text: Then the Confederations Cup. And then it all goes wrong.

scene.title: From the top to the bottom

items.label: World Cup: out in the group
World Cup: out in the group

lines.text: This summer, Paraguay knock them out on penalties. Germany had never lost a World Cup shoot-out before.
lines.say: This summer, Parragwhy knock them out on penalties. Germany had never lost a World Cup shoot-out before.

scene.headline: Paraguay stun Germany in shoot-out
scene.standfirst: One-all after extra time in Foxborough, then 4-3 on penalties. It is Germany's first ever World Cup shoot-out defeat.

lines.text: So here's the twist. While Ronaldo played, Portugal won more than Germany. Three trophies to two.
Now the alternate world. Ronaldo is German, and it's the World Cup final in Rio.
Extra time against Argentina. In real life, Mario Götze volleyed the winner. Here, it's Ronaldo.
lines.say: Extra time against Argentina. In real life, Mario Gurtser volleyed the winner. Here, it's Ronaldo.

lines.text: He finally gets a World Cup. But that night in Paris, the Euro for his own country, never happens.
World champion, or champion of Europe with his own country? Which would you pick? Tell me in the comments.
